primary_result: No EP2 in the searched domain; quantitative bounds; the U(2) multiplet channel is closed exactly by a direct-sum Jordan-structure theorem.

bounds.note: One separation bound and one conditioning diagnostic. The former is a difference of tracked eigenvalues, each confirmed by ODE residual ~1e-12 and cross-solver agreement <= 2.06e-9.

next_scientific_gate: Hyperboloidal formulation (Solver F): the only method that remains applicable in the quasiresonant regime, which is the one region of the spectrum this search could not cover.

manuscript.target: PRD. PRL explicitly declined -- see cover_letter_prl.tex for the reasoning, recorded so the decision is deliberate rather than an omission.
manuscript.style: Modelled on Kokkotas & Schmidt, Living Rev. Relativity 2, 2 (1999) [gr-qc/9909058]: single column, hierarchical numbered sections, heavy numbered equations, tables of numerical values, few figures, technical derivations in appendices.
manuscript.figure_style: greyscale, Computer Modern, open/filled markers, labelled level curves instead of filled colour maps; survives monochrome printing

ringdown.finding: No exceptional phenomenology. The strongest interactions split in Im omega (0.53) rather than Re omega (8e-4 to 0.07): nearly equal oscillation frequencies, very different decay rates. The EP template beats a single damped exponential by only 2.4x while using twice the free amplitudes.
ringdown.note: A large t_beat/tau (up to 1.4e4 here) is NOT sufficient evidence of near-EP behaviour; secular growth needs coalescence in the full complex frequency.

WITHDRAWN.min_root_separation: WITHDRAWN. |a1/a2| measures the distance to the nearest zero OR POLE; Leaver's CF is meromorphic and the contour integral returns zeros-minus-poles = 0 out to radius 0.20, so the quoted value was a pole distance. See docs/FAILED_APPROACHES.md.
WITHDRAWN.min_abs_discriminant: WITHDRAWN as independent. D = (w+ - w-)^2 is the square of the gap (0.5116^2 = 0.26176); one quantity reported twice.
